In this vignette, we show how to use **lglasso** package to estimate one-stage/ two-stage network model from longitudinal data. 

In  section 1 and 2, we use simulated data to demonstrate how to use the two main function *lglasso()* and *CVlglasso()* respectively. 

In section 3 and 4, we apply the model to a real antibody titer data from a large vaccine study.
